not_measured.E: chaos (ledger and broker kill) not implemented in M1-06a
not_measured.G_symlinks: M1 kernels perform no filesystem access; symlink paths exercise string handling only
not_measured.broker_timing: B, B-mem, H and H-mem report per-operation broker timing from bench-broker-scenario (validation, kernel decision, key-lock wait, each transaction's begin/body/end, parse and run per line, process and protocol overhead) in separate timed runs
not_measured.ledgers: B and H use the file-backed SQLite ledger (D-023, fresh database per process); B-mem and H-mem use the in-memory model and are not substitutes for the SQLite results

A.method: kernel_decision_ns: per-decision time inside the prototype (bench-decide), excluding JSON parsing, encoding and I/O; batch wall: process launch to exit over warm-up plus measured lines

B.method: one broker-scenario per session, each ending in one concurrent group of 10 executes (in-process threads); checked against every permitted serialization with D-026 evidence; successful throughput counts only successful operations; refusals are reported under availability, never as work

meta.concurrency_profile: cold (supplemental, D-027; reported separately, never combined with primary)

B-cold.method: one broker-scenario per session, each ending in one concurrent group of 10 executes (in-process threads); checked against every permitted serialization with D-026 evidence; successful throughput counts only successful operations; refusals are reported under availability, never as work

meta.ledger: in-memory model (simulated; not a substitute for the SQLite workload)

B-mem.method: one broker-scenario per session, each ending in one concurrent group of 10 executes (in-process threads); checked against every permitted serialization with D-026 evidence; successful throughput counts only successful operations; refusals are reported under availability, never as work

meta.note: invalid UTF-8 lines are answered with a null id (D-021)
